title: PILLAGER SURVIVAL LEVEL
why: His progression answers 16, 17, 19, 20, 29 and 52: all earned SP fills the living pillager through level 20. Curve: next level costs 1000 + 150*(level-1), cumulative 44650 at 20. Flight recorder exports/run-20261107-190409-065.txt has 37 extracted runs, median reconstructed base kill SP 1525 (range 200 to 5925), or 3050 with extraction x2: 14.64 surviving raids to cap, before elite, difficulty, vault and style bonuses. First 3050 SP gains two levels; 3450 gains three. Watch: bonus-heavy raids may level faster; check pace and HUD clearance at 1080p and 4K.
now: Career health panel has a six-pixel survival level bar. Every career SP award fills it immediately; extraction and condition bonus count once. Names over heads show the survival level. Demo has no progression bar. Existing pillager fields reload without a migration or a new storage key.
